correctness.rationale: For s≠0 the product parameter z=ab/s² has weight 1+χ(1−4z) and target W(z)=(1−2z)/z². Its only possible distinct partner is z/(2z−1); the exclusions 0,1/2,1 are correct. The only odd weight is at 1/4, with partner −1/2 of weight 1+χ(3), giving exactly one odd fiber per nonzero s. At s=0 all nonempty fibers are twofold. The elliptic cubic has distinct roots and one point at infinity; its character sum is −a_q. In the expansion of the off-diagonal product, the three excluded values contribute a combined 7+χ(−1)+2χ(−3), so the restricted sum is q−7−2χ(−1)−2χ(−3)−a_q. The repaired proof assigns the off-diagonal weight 8 to each fourfold fiber, 4 to each threefold fiber and zero to all others; this gives M4 and then M2,M0 and the sumset via counting. Hasse gives strict positivity for q≥29 via q−15−2√q>0. The eight remaining eligible fields have M4=0,0,0,0,16,36,66,48 in increasing order. This includes the nonprime field 25.
residual_risks: Finite reproduction certifies bounded cases; the collision argument and Hasse bound establish the all-field result. No weighted sharp extension assertion or formal attestation.
